title: Boundary Regularity for Fully Nonlinear Singular Elliptic Equations
summary: We study boundary regularity for the fully nonlinear singular elliptic equation of the form $|Du|^γF(D^2u)=f$, where $-1<γ<0$. First, we prove pointwise boundary $C^{1,α}$ estimates with pointwise $C^{1,α}$ Dirichlet data, which weakens the $C^2$ domain smoothness requirement from Birindelli and Demengel~\cite{BD10}. The proof uses compactness and perturbation, without flattening the boundary.
